label: Turret v5 (one servo, contact parts)
describe: Turret v5 (Ben 2026-11-16), contact geometry only: one motor (flywheel + the squishy geared off it, as v4c) and ONE servo. Every hood part swings about the flywheel axle. POLLEN hood: a lower half (entry piece + 2 side teeth, on a hard stop) and a top half (1 central tooth, the servo); NECTAR: 2 static side teeth on the ring + 1 central tooth the POLLEN hood pulls. The angle slider sets the exit inside each ball's zone; changing the ball swings the POLLEN hood up over the wheel.
